Solve this Python programming problem.

Write a function to join a list of multiple integers into a single integer.

Your code must pass tests like this one:
assert multiple_to_single([11, 33, 50])==113350

Reply with the complete solution in a single ```python code block. Include any imports it needs. Don't include the tests.
text:
```python
def multiple_to_single(nums):
    # Convert each integer in the list to a string
    str_nums = [str(num) for num in nums]
    # Join the string representations into a single string
    single_str = ''.join(str_nums)
    # Convert the single string back to an integer
    single_num = int(single_str)
    return single_num
```
